backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor defining Property types (office/retail, furnishing status), CRUD operations with access control, location-based search, and user profile management with authorization checks.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting the requirement to update Select.Item components in PropertySearchBar.tsx to use non-empty value props instead of empty strings.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend files including components, pages, hooks, and styling with emphasis on pure black text/icons on saturated yellow backgrounds and location search functionality.
frontend/index.css: Global CSS with Tailwind layers defining OKLCH color system variables for light and dark modes with neutral grayscale tokens.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with root div and module script loading main.tsx.
frontend/public/googlea70a8e0aae5c8967.h: Google site verification HTML file with verification meta tag.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component configuring TanStack Router with routes for public listings, listing details, and agent arena pages, wrapped in ThemeProvider with Toaster.
frontend/src/components/agent/MultiPhoto: Multi-image upload component handling file selection, progress tracking, preview display, and removal with ExternalBlob integration and toast notifications.
frontend/src/components/agent/PropertyFo: Reusable property form component with controlled inputs for all property fields including title, location, type, furnishing, area, price, description, images, washrooms, and permit number.
frontend/src/components/auth/AgentProtec: Protected route component that checks agent code authorization and redirects unauthorized users to the agent entry page, displaying an access denied card if needed.
frontend/src/components/layout/SiteFoote: Footer component displaying copyright, year, and a branded link to caffeine.ai with UTM tracking parameters.
frontend/src/components/layout/SiteHeade: Sticky header component with logo, navigation links to Properties and Agent Arena pages.
frontend/src/components/layout/SiteLayou: Main layout wrapper component that combines SiteHeader, main content area, and SiteFooter in a flex column layout.
frontend/src/components/listings/Contact: Button component that opens WhatsApp with a pre-filled message containing property title and URL to contact agent at a specific phone number.
frontend/src/components/listings/Propert: Card component displaying property summary with image, title, location, area, price, washrooms, and property type badge, linking to detailed listing page.
Image gallery component with main image display and thumbnail carousel for navigating through property images.
frontend/src/components/search/PropertyS: Search bar component with filters for location (with autocomplete), property type, furnishing status, area range, and price range, featuring keyboard navigation for suggestions.
frontend/src/config/publicEnv.ts: Configuration module that exports public environment variables, specifically the Google Places API key from Vite build-time env vars.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React Query hook that creates and manages backend actor instances with Internet Identity authentication, handling admin token initialization and query invalidation on identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useDebouncedValue.ts: Custom hook that debounces a value by delaying updates for a specified time period (default 300ms).
frontend/src/hooks/useGooglePlacesAutoco: Hook for Google Places Autocomplete API that fetches location suggestions restricted to UAE with Dubai bias, handling API loading, debouncing, and session tokens.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides React context and hooks for Internet Identity authentication, managing login state, identity persistence, and delegation validation with configurable AuthClient options.
frontend/src/hooks/useLocationAutocomple: Hook that wraps backend autocomplete suggestions to provide location-only search suggestions from stored property data.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for all backend API calls including user profiles, property searches, autocomplete suggestions, and CRUD operations with proper caching and error handling.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom light soft yellow theme using pure black text for both light and dark modes, plus utility classes for hero sections, property cards, and search containers.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query client and Internet Identity provider, then renders the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/agent/AgentArenaEntry: Agent authentication page that validates agent codes using agentCodeAuth utility and redirects to dashboard upon successful authorization.
frontend/src/pages/agent/AgentDashboardP: Agent dashboard page displaying property statistics (total, office, retail counts) with navigation to add new properties or manage existing ones. Includes logout functionality that clears agent authorization and query cache.
frontend/src/pages/agent/ManagePropertie: Property management page for agents to view, edit, and delete their listed properties. Handles deletion with error normalization and displays appropriate toast messages for authorization and backend errors.
frontend/src/pages/agent/PropertyEditorP: Property creation and editing page that handles form submission for both new and existing properties. Uses normalized error handling to display specific backend error messages and authorization failures.
frontend/src/pages/ListingDetailsPage.ts: Displays detailed property information including image gallery, specifications, amenities, and contact agent button with WhatsApp sharing functionality.
frontend/src/pages/PublicListingsPage.ts: Public-facing homepage with hero section and property search functionality, displaying filtered property cards in a responsive grid layout.
frontend/src/utils/agentCodeAuth.ts: Agent authentication utility managing local authorization state using a hardcoded agent code (050702) stored in localStorage. Provides methods to check authorization, verify codes, logout, and retrieve the agent code for backend calls.
frontend/src/utils/backendError.ts: Error normalization utility that extracts clean error messages from backend responses by removing canister error wrappers and identifying authorization-related errors. Returns structured error objects with message, auth flag, and original error.
frontend/src/utils/googlePlacesLoader.ts: Google Maps JavaScript API loader that asynchronously loads the Places library once and tracks loading state. Provides functions to check if the API is loaded and retrieve any load errors.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: URL parameter parsing utilities supporting both regular query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence. Includes functions to extract, store, retrieve, and clear URL parameters across navigation.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration file that sets up dark mode, custom color scheme using OKLCH color space with CSS variables, typography, container queries, animations, and custom font families (Inter).
project_state.json: Project state tracking file indicating a fix request to update Select.Item components in PropertyForm.tsx and PropertySearchBar.tsx to use non-empty value props instead of empty strings to resolve validation errors.
